# LowPower_Neuromorphic_Denoising

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
Use of event-driven spiking computation to perform speech denoising under strict implant power and latency budgets. Critical for iNEST because implantable auditory devices require milliwatt-scale, always-on processing.
